movie.title: Aroopi
movie.overview: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When two thieves accidentally release a vengeful Yakshini bound inside an ancient doll, the sole surviving heir of the Aryanattu estate must return home to confront his family's dark legacy.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: An ancient curse is awakened at the Aryanattu estate when two unsuspecting thieves inadvertently free a malevolent Yakshini trapped within a sealed doll. Following a gruesome murder on the grounds, Niranjan, the last heir to the bloodline, is summoned back to his ancestral home. To survive the entity's wrath, he must unearth the dark, long-buried secrets of his ancestors. As the spirit's vengeance grows stronger, Niranjan finds himself in a deadly race to break the curse before it consumes him.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: For generations, the Aryanattu estate held a dark secret, binding a vengeful spirit known as a Yakshini inside a mysterious doll to protect the family line. That ancient seal is shattered when two foolish thieves break into the estate seeking valuables and inadvertently release the malevolent entity. Freed from her imprisonment, the spirit unleashes immediate terror, culminating in a brutal murder that shocks the local community. The violence forces Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the Aryanattu lineage, to return to the decaying ancestral mansion he long abandoned. Upon his arrival, Niranjan is plagued by unsettling visions and atmospheric horrors that hint at a deep-seated tragedy within his family tree. Guided by cryptic clues left behind by his forebears, he attempts to piece together the history of the curse and the reason for the Yakshini's intense wrath. However, the vengeful spirit targets anyone connected to the bloodline, turning the estate into a claustrophobic trap of supernatural terror. Niranjan must navigate betrayals, spectral illusions, and the sins of his ancestors to uncover the truth. Ultimately, he is forced into a final, high-stakes confrontation to bind the ancient evil before it eradicates the last of his family.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Aroopi is a supernatural horror thriller centered around the legendary Aryanattu estate and a deadly curse bound to its lineage. The story begins when two thieves accidentally release a malevolent Yakshini that had been safely sealed inside a doll for decades. The resulting brutal murder draws Niranjan, the sole remaining heir of the estate, back to his ancestral home. As supernatural phenomena escalate, Niranjan is thrust into a suspenseful investigation of his family's dark past to discover why the spirit was bound and how to stop her terrifying rampage before the entire bloodline is wiped out.

story_structure.climax: Niranjan faces the unleashed Yakshini in a high-stakes, direct confrontation at the heart of the ancestral home, forcing a final reckoning between the family's past sins and the entity's vengeance.
story_structure.conflict: Niranjan must confront a lethal entity terrorizing the estate while grappling with the long-buried, sinister truths of his own family's history.
story_structure.resolution: The violent legacy of the Aryanattu estate comes to an end, leaving Niranjan to pick up the pieces of his shattered lineage in the aftermath of the curse's breaking.
story_structure.introduction: Niranjan, the last heir of the Aryanattu lineage, returns to his ancestral estate following a gruesome murder, unaware that two thieves have inadvertently freed a vengeful Yakshini previously bound within a doll.
story_structure.risingAction: As supernatural occurrences escalate and more secrets surface, Niranjan races to uncover the origins of the curse and the connection between his ancestors and the Yakshini before she destroys everything.
